title: Mod manifest (site/registry-relevant subset)
description: Contract for edge E1 (N1 -> N5, mod layout + mod.lua fields, ADR-0030 subset) in docs/architecture/depgraph.md. mod.lua (ADR-0030) returns a much larger table -- depends/optional/conflicts/load_after/extends/provides/wants/permissions/server/client/data_version/declares and more -- all of it meaningful only to the kernel and the compiler, neither of which exists yet (mission SITE-V1 Section 2: kernel is explicitly out of scope). This schema validates only the fields the registry pipeline and the static site need without a kernel, exactly as this task's acceptance criterion 4 lists them: id, name, version, api_version, license, source, type, description, tags, screenshots, ai_assisted. `additionalProperties: false` below means this document is that deliberately restricted subset, not the literal, complete mod.lua table -- a fuller manifest contract with the kernel-relevant fields is future work once the kernel exists, out of this task's declared scope (booked under Questions).

id.description: namespace:name (ADR-0030: "id (namespace:name)"). Must match the registry entry's own `id` (entry.schema.json) -- that cross-check is pipeline logic, out of scope for this task (task 007).

version.description: ADR-0030: mod.lua field "version (semver)". Must match the version being published in the same entry.json PR -- a pipeline-side cross-check, out of scope here.

api_version.description: ADR-0030: mod.lua field "api_version". No ADR read for this task fixes its exact syntax (a single semver? a range?) -- kept as a non-empty string here rather than inventing a format; booked under Questions in docs/tasks/006-contracts.md.

license.$comment: OSI-approved SPDX license identifiers (139 entries), vendored as data per this task's instructions (never hand-written from memory). Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/main/json/licenses.json (the SPDX license-list-data project's canonical machine-readable license list), filtered to entries where isOsiApproved is true and isDeprecatedLicenseId is false. Fetched 2026-09-03. Upstream licenseListVersion "7661985", releaseDate "2026-09-02T00:00:00Z". ADR-0049: "Mods: any OSI-approved licence". This enum accepts a single SPDX license identifier only -- not a full SPDX license expression (e.g. "MIT OR Apache-2.0"); booked under Questions as a scope decision, since ADR-0049 does not say whether dual-licensing must be supported.
license.description: ADR-0049: "Mods: any OSI-approved licence (open source is mandatory -- ADR-0040)". "LicenseRef-Proprietary" and "NOASSERTION" are valid SPDX syntax but neither is an OSI-approved license identifier, so both are rejected by this enum -- they name the absence of an open license, not one.

source.description: ADR-0030: mod.lua field "source" -- the mod's own public git repository URL, any host (ADR-0058 Section 4). Same provider-neutral URL shape as entry.schema.json's `versions[].source_url`.

screenshots.description: ADR-0030: mod.lua field "screenshots". Same relative-path constraint as page.schema.json's `screenshots` -- pages are built from the archive, never the live web (ADR-0059 Section 1), and a manifest screenshot is what page.json's screenshot list is seeded from at first publish.

items.description: A POSIX-style relative path inside the mod's own source tree, never an absolute URL or filesystem path -- see page.schema.json's `screenshots` for the identical rule.

ai_assisted.description: ADR-0030: mod.lua field "ai_assisted (true / false / omitted -- omitted shows nothing)". Optional: not in `required`, matching "omitted" being an explicit valid state rather than a default value.
